correctness.rationale: Leaf-block deletion proves the exact induction generating every connected cactus on up to nine vertices; removing a nonarticulation vertex gives a second complete augmentation. Exact graph-isomorphism deduplication and exhaustive fixed-root automorphism tests at every root yield graph-type counts 1,1,2,4,9,23,63,188,596 and rooted-failure vector 0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,1. Both embedded programs and their replayed output support this finite exhaustive claim. The explicit nine-vertex pentagon with two adjacent-root-neighbour triangles has a stable (1,2,6) partition versus rooted orbit sizes (1,2,2,4); no larger-order claim is made.
